digest.component_or_area: CLI argument parsing and command dispatch (S2a migration)
propositions: Advanced command grammars (bridge, reconcile, audit, review, workflow, identity, gate) currently mix inline argparse construction with manual dispatch, creating 21 unsafe/incomplete top-level help forms and preventing parser reuse across commands.
Parser factories must be extracted and centralized in lean modules without importing optional runtimes (Pydantic AI, FastAPI, Jira transport, metrics, tracing), enabling deterministic S2d generation.
Commands currently using SystemExit(2) on parse failure must transition to catching ParseError and reproducing identical exit codes and stderr/usage bytes via S2a RebarArgumentParser.

Parser construction must preserve bespoke presentation (custom usage strings, RawDescriptionHelpFormatter, add_help=False) for verify-opcert, verify-commit, verify-authorship, remote-cert, trusted-env, and nested bridge parsers through optional S2a factory parameters.

Canonical and compatibility command variants (bridge, bridge-fsck, bridge-probe, jira-onboard, bridge-status) must share argument-definition helpers while retaining distinct prog names and visibility modes.

Every advanced route must have a valid, recorded factory reference and pass registry-driven tests constructing RebarArgumentParser instances with heavy optional runtimes import-blocked, proving S2d-generation-readiness without handler execution.
